physical: The weak interaction treats matter and antimatter slightly differently: the combined operation of charge conjugation and parity is not an exact symmetry.
reflected_sentence: A slight difference between two kinds keeps, and neither kind has a frozen partner.
rule_reason: No cost or separation is given. Zero such costs keep the relationship. It is not itself an identity or a symmetry; it says a symmetry is inexact. Nothing in it has a frozen partner.
interpretation: The Current is not this relationship. Movement is not in it. The relationship does not turn.
closing: The rule decides the keep on its own: no costs, so the count is even and the reading does not turn. I did not treat a broken symmetry as a resistance-cost. Every operative term lacks a frozen partner, and I introduced none, so the keep has almost no content to state. That is a vocabulary failure, not a shape change. Charge was not mapped to Idle; that would be a reinterpretation.
